name: Playground Slide
instruction: Imagine a playground. I need you to create a 3D model of a slide. The slide should be curved and about 6 feet tall. Don't forget to include the ladder.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a slide.
The slide has a curved shape.
The slide is designed to allow for smooth descent.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The slide's height is proportionate to its base.
The ladder is proportionate to the height of the slide.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The slide is positioned securely on the ground.
The ladder is correctly aligned with the slide.
The curve of the slide is appropriately designed for descent.
Object distance and contact: The base of the slide is stable and does not wobble.
The ladder connects securely to the slide.
There is no gap between the slide and the ground.

Instruction execution accuracy: The slide is accurately represented as curved and 6 feet tall.
The ladder is included as specified.
